title: Isla
intro_text:
A gray afternoon in November. You have just ridden through the last of the school traffic.

You are Isla, a child psychologist at Willow House, a children's counseling center in an old brick house on a corner. Today is your third session with a six-year-old named Wren.

You chain the bike to the porch rail and unclip the canvas bag. Through the glass in the green door you can see her, alone on a low chair in the waiting room, with a rabbit in her lap.
